ratification.verbatim: 미국 자료 수집 워크플로(free-market-data.yml)에 저장소 반영 재시도를 추가하고, 그에 따른 지문 기록 갱신을 승인한다. 수집 대상과 출처는 변경하지 않는다.

registry_binding.reason: The ratified fingerprint update is recorded here instead of in the registry because the registry file's own bytes are sha256-bound by config/crypto_paper_runtime_v1.json and config/kr_paper_runtime_ratification_candidate_v1.json, and regime/crypto_paper_runtime.py and regime/kr_paper_runtime_ratification_candidate.py both fail closed with POLICY_BINDING_DRIFT on any byte change. Editing the registry in place would therefore have forced config/crypto_paper_runtime_v1.json to change, which changes regime/crypto_paper_runtime.py POLICY_SHA256, which changes config/crypto_candidate_promotion_contract_v3.json regime_source.policy_sha256 and universe/crypto_candidate_promotion.py CONTRACT_V3_SHA256 -- and universe/crypto_candidate_promotion.py then requires the runtime decision packet's policy_sha256 to equal the contract's, so the seven retained, append-only decision packets under evidence/regime/crypto_paper_runtime/2026-09-14..2026-09-17 would have had to be rewritten to keep the crypto promotion path from failing closed. Rewriting retained evidence is not what was ratified and is not permitted. This file is therefore the same separate-additional-ratification, additive-overlay pattern config/us_session_calendar_source_v1.json, config/paper_runtime_normalization_v1.json and config/regime_semantic_freshness_policy_v1.json already use, bound to the registry's exact current bytes.

change.step_name: Commit immutable evidence and latest pointer
change.fail_closed: A rebase conflict aborts the rebase and returns non-zero; exhausting the attempts returns non-zero. A dropped commit is never reported as success.

cause.capture_result_in_those_runs: alpaca_status=READY status=PASS; evidence files were written and then lost with the rejected push
cause.preliminary_step_lines_are_not_the_cause: ALPACA_CAPTURE_FAILED:HTTP_ERROR:401 and BLOCKED_BY_DEDICATED_MARKET_DATA_CREDENTIAL (both status PARTIAL) in the same run logs come from preliminary credential-less steps, not from the dedicated market-data capture.
cause.downstream_symptom: regime/us_paper_runtime_publication.py read a 2026-09-15 packet on 2026-09-18 because no newer capture was ever committed.
